title: Parkio Daily for November 11, 2026
teaser: Fantastic Four meet-and-greet debuts at Avengers Campus; WDW resorts drop to $99/night for late 2026; EPCOT Festival of the Arts lineup announced.

breaking.title: Fantastic Four characters now meeting guests at Avengers Campus
breaking.body: Disneyland Resort introduced Fantastic Four character encounters at Avengers Campus to celebrate the December 18 theatrical release of Avengers: Doomsday. The Super Hero experiences launch today alongside other interactive elements tied to the film.

parkioInsight.text: Character meet queues at Avengers Campus tend to spike mid-morning. Arriving at park opening usually offers shorter waits for new character debuts like this one.

breaking.title: Walt Disney World resort rooms drop to $99 per night through early 2027
breaking.body: Disney released a resort discount offering up to 50 percent off select accommodations for late 2026 and early 2027, with nightly rates starting at $99 for Value resorts. The offer is available to the general public.

parkioInsight.text: Deep discounts like this often signal softer demand windows. Booking now for January through March 2027 may offer lower park crowds alongside the hotel savings.

bignews.title: Indiana Jones Epic Jr. play area confirmed for Hollywood Studios
bignews.body: Disney confirmed construction underway outside Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular for a new junior-focused play space. The project, previously filed as Project Fedora, will offer an adventure-themed area for younger guests.

parkioInsight.text: Construction noise near Sunset Boulevard tends to be loudest before noon. Plan quieter dining or indoor attractions in that zone after 1pm until the work wraps.

bignews.title: Disneyland announces multi-day ticket discount for early 2027
bignews.body: Disneyland Resort will offer discounted 2-day and 3-day tickets for 2027 visits, marking the first general-public ticket deal announced for next year. Sale dates and booking windows are expected soon.

parkioInsight.text: Ticket promotions typically cover off-peak dates. Booking early often locks in the best rate before blackout calendars fill or inventory sells out.

bignews.title: Napa Rose debuts à la carte menu alongside prix fixe dining
bignews.body: Napa Rose at Disney's Grand Californian Hotel added a new à la carte menu option in the main dining room, complementing its existing prix fixe offerings. Seasonal dishes rotate based on ingredient availability.

parkioInsight.text: The à la carte option may offer more flexibility for smaller appetites or budgets. Reservations at Napa Rose tend to book weeks ahead for dinner service.

bignews.title: EPCOT Festival of the Arts 2027 Broadway lineup revealed
bignews.body: Disney announced the full Disney on Broadway Concert Series schedule for EPCOT International Festival of the Arts, running January 15 through March 1, 2027. Six new performers join the 10th anniversary celebration, with dining packages now bookable.

parkioInsight.text: Dining packages for Broadway performances often sell out within days of release. Booking now secures preferred seating and a guaranteed meal reservation for popular showtimes.

topstories.title: Swan and Dolphin Food and Wine Classic returns November 2026
topstories.body: The annual Food and Wine Classic at Walt Disney World's Swan and Dolphin hotels is scheduled for later this month. The multi-night dining event features tastings, chef demonstrations, and specialty pairings.

parkioInsight.text: The Swan and Dolphin event tends to draw crowds outside the parks. Consider attending on an EPCOT rest day to sample premium dining without using park admission.

topstories.title: New meet-and-greet for latest Disney film coming to both coasts
topstories.body: Disney announced character meet-and-greets tied to its newest theatrical release will debut at both Disneyland and Walt Disney World in the coming weeks. Specific characters and locations are expected to be confirmed soon.

parkioInsight.text: New character debuts often draw long queues during the first two weeks. Arriving at the meet location within 30 minutes of park opening usually offers the shortest waits.

topstories.title: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party debuts new cast member costumes
topstories.body: Magic Kingdom introduced redesigned cast member attire for the 2026 Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party season. The updated uniforms have sparked mixed reactions among fans attending early November events.

parkioInsight.text: The party is already underway with new entertainment and holiday treats. Tickets for late November and December tend to sell out, so booking soon is advisable if you plan to attend.

topstories.title: Brother Bear Loungefly collection launched by Disney
topstories.body: A new Loungefly line featuring Brother Bear characters is now available. The collection spotlights a less-frequently merchandised Disney film with bags and accessories.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-run Loungefly releases tend to sell out quickly at flagship Disney stores and online. Check shopDisney early in the day for best selection before stock runs low.

topstories.title: Membership Magic Beyond returns for 2027 with no price increase
topstories.body: Disney confirmed Membership Magic Beyond will continue for a third year in 2027, adding improved perks while holding the membership fee steady. The program offers discounts and benefits across both Walt Disney World and Disneyland Resort.

parkioInsight.text: If you visit parks multiple times per year, the membership may offset costs on dining, merchandise, and resort stays. Compare the perks against your typical spending to gauge value.

topstories.title: Imagineering developing app to reduce guest phone reliance in parks
topstories.body: The head of Walt Disney Imagineering revealed work on a new app designed to reduce screen time during park visits, using emerging technology to keep guests more engaged with their surroundings. Details on features and release timing remain unannounced.

parkioInsight.text: Any future shift away from phone-dependent planning could simplify mornings. For now, keeping your device charged and the My Disney Experience app updated remains the most reliable strategy.

icymi.title: Shanghai Disney Enchanted Star Hotel opens December 16
icymi.body: Shanghai Disney Resort confirmed its third on-property hotel, the 400-room Enchanted Star Hotel, will welcome guests starting December 16, 2026. The family-focused property sits along Wishing Star Lake near Shanghai Disneyland Hotel.

icymi.title: Disney confirms participation in 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
icymi.body: Disney will take part in the 100th anniversary of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade this November. The company has been a longtime participant in the annual New York City event marking the start of the holiday season.

icymi.title: ABC filming annual Christmas special at Magic Kingdom this week
icymi.body: Magic Kingdom is hosting production for ABC's annual Christmas television programming, bringing special entertainment, seasonal decorations, and surprise character appearances to the park during filming.

spotlight.title: Grand Floridian Cafe reopens with new breakfast and lunch menu
spotlight.body: The Grand Floridian Cafe has returned to service at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort after a refurbishment, debuting updated breakfast and lunch offerings. The table-service restaurant provides a convenient dining option for monorail-accessible parks.

parkioInsight.text: Newly reopened resort restaurants often have availability in the first few weeks. Booking a late breakfast here before heading to Magic Kingdom may offer a quieter start than in-park dining.
